description: instagram: Embed HTML. GET /v1/instagram/user/embed. Get the HTML of an Instagram profile's embed widget (instagram.com/<handle>/embed/). Profiles that are private, missing or not embeddable fail at 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

handle.description: The Instagram username, with or without @
